source_binding.density_basis: Public QNRAIN is kg-1 dry air, driver internal number is QNRAIN*DEN, KDM6 uses qrs=QRAIN and lambda^3=pidnr*nrs/(qrs*DEN); DEN cancels from the inversion.

prior.lambda_policy: geometric midpoint of source lambda bounds
prior.fill_condition: captured baseline first-KDM6 call cell AND QRAIN > qcrmin AND QNRAIN exactly zero
prior.below_nrmin_policy: retain candidate values below nrmin and report their count; do not add a floor
prior.cap_policy: reject before forecast if candidate QNRAIN*actual first-entry DEN exceeds source nrmax on any called cell; do not clip

required_first_call_capture.purpose: Use baseline full-global first-KDM6 ENTRY density only as a cap-screening proxy at cells actually called by the fixed B1 executable.
required_first_call_capture.stage_boundary: Do not require baseline ENTRY QRAIN/QNRAIN to equal initial wrfinput QRAIN/QNRAIN; startup dynamics can change them.
required_first_call_capture.baseline_cap_screen: Candidate input QNRAIN multiplied by captured baseline ENTRY DEN must be <= source nrmax at all called cells; reject on exceedance. This is a planning screen, not proof of candidate first-call state.

candidate_runtime_gate.capture: Actual candidate first-KDM6 ENTRY QRAIN, QNRAIN, and DEN at the same called cells after startup.
candidate_runtime_gate.validation: Reconstruct source-consumed lambda only where source-active and internal Nr exceeds nrmin; report source branches/clamps separately and verify candidate entry cap. Do not require the exact prior center when source Q/QN startup transformations or nrmin/lambda guards alter the consumed state.
candidate_runtime_gate.preservation: The prior changes initial QNRAIN only. Candidate ENTRY values are observations of the later runtime stage and must not be relabeled as input values.
